summary: The registrant, 17 Education & Technology Group Inc., filed a Form 6-K reporting a change in its independent registered public accounting firm. The board and audit committee dismissed Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu and appointed Marcum Asia CPAs LLP, effective May 27, 2026, for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2026. The filing states no disagreements or reportable events occurred with the predecessor auditor. This is a routine auditor change disclosure required for foreign private issuers and does not represent a special situation such as a merger, acquisition, or restructuring. No deal terms are applicable.
